review.method: Independent comparison of all 80 translations with original disc source and eight adjacent context rows. Checked direction, source-defined subject, action state, branch condition and inclusive altitude comparison. All line-break controls preserved; scrolling-hint presentation and native UI playtesting remain pending.

source_storage: Source text remains on the original disc; bind by inventory ID and SHA-256.

notes.401: Controller-help ticker clauses use five-space separators in place of five ideographic spaces; preserve the terminal separator and verify scrolling in game.
notes.402: B/Y are alternative cancellation buttons, not a required simultaneous chord. Start confirms the name; A confirms the selected character.
notes.404: L/R adjust rotation speed, distinct from position adjustment by analog stick and fine adjustment by the D-pad.
notes.405: The selected area is adjusted and confirmed; X switches scale. Do not turn this into selecting one menu item.
notes.406: The source omits what the left/right controls adjust. Retain the generic Adjust label until the active settings screen supplies it.
notes.407: The source omits what the left/right controls adjust; keep generic Adjust. L/R explicitly rotate the Marionette.
notes.413: STANDSTILL is the source's Latin preset name; the enemy stays stationary.
notes.414: MIRROR performs the same type of motion with left and right reversed, not a screen reflection.
notes.416: OLD PROGRAM uses the program from before the current edits; this is not an old game version.
notes.417: There is a storage gap between menu rows 416 and 417; translation binding must use inventory IDs rather than assume all menu text is contiguous.
notes.419: Chip-help actions are performed by your Marionette. Restore that known subject in English instead of a subjectless description.
notes.429: Stops the Marionette by canceling movement, dash or jump state; do not imply only normal movement is canceled.
notes.447: Dash rotation combines turning right with dashing; exact animation remains untested.
notes.448: Dash rotation combines turning left with dashing; exact animation remains untested.
notes.449: Burner acceleration is distinct from ordinary dashing; retain burner rather than invent a thruster type.
notes.462: The enemy is currently marked by your Marionette. Marking is kept distinct from an unsupported missile lock-on interpretation.
notes.464: The unnumbered Option equipment label is preserved; the source does not explicitly say Option 1 in this action description.
notes.467: The source says the Option has little remaining without naming ammunition, charge or uses. Running low preserves this omission.
notes.468: The source says Option 2 has little remaining without specifying ammunition, charge or uses; preserve the omission.
notes.469: Conditional chip descriptions concern the program's blue-arrow branch, with your Marionette as the unit being tested.
notes.479: The condition is that your Marionette has been hit, not that its own attack hit an enemy.
